title: Measured gate scans: eight (L)-laws empty, mix3 inhabited free, sign-split family at v_2
statement: Measured evidence only. The original closed-form instrument and an independent audit instrument reproduce the exact sign-split algebra, Gaussian rank collapse, a mix3 root near beta = 0, and the qualitative centered-versus-noncentered library behavior. The original product-bimodal and dependent-(L) scans found no roots within beta in [-2.5,2.5] and at most three continued Lloyd branches; this is windowed finite-search evidence, not proof that the gate is empty. The mix3 search found one root near beta = 0 with cuts near +-1.00476, lambda_min near 1.7364, and value numerically equal to the efficient interval optimum; it does not prove global uniqueness, sufficiency, or an empirical transfer theorem. The Gaussian sign-split family has exact profiled value 2/pi and maximum lambda_min 1/pi; the reported v_3-v_2 = 0.173206 is numerical.
assumptions: population quantities are closed-form Phi/phi mixture algebra, no sampling; Monte Carlo appears only in violation scans and library runs with deterministic seeds SEED_BASE = 20260831
measured, never theorem authority; scan grids and branch multistarts are finite - absence of roots on a grid is evidence, the proof is DS17.1
the original scan window was not derived from 2M/kappa for a declared kappa and its branch cap could miss isolated roots
independent audit provenance and tolerances are stored as separate mode artifacts under AUDITS/artifacts/AUDIT-DS-STABLE-BASINS-001/
